original_test_intent: Validate the AMD OOB RAS path for one UMC uncorrectable address/command-parity event by proving it creates exactly one attributable CPER whose decoded component, error type and severity match the injection.
original_method: Capture platform/GPU/OAM/BMC identity, health and complete CPER baseline; validate source `/redfish/v1/Systems/UBB/LogServices/Dump/Entries` on the actual secure endpoint; prove amdgpuras device0/block0 mapping; run the literal severity4/type4/mode1 command once; query entries and select the unique new index; download its attachment to a safe temporary path, transfer with verified hash, decode with pinned cdump_analyzer and validate OAM, UMC, ext4, AddressCommandParityErr and fatal severity; verify recovery and remove only approved temporary copies.
manual_activity: AMD/board owner maps the numeric target and approves OOB injection/recovery; agent may query the validated BMC endpoint, transfer/hash the unique CPER and decode it after the qualified operator fires one mode1 injection.
required_inputs: Platform/UBB/BMC/host and all AMD GPU UUID/OAM/BDF/firmware/driver topology
amdgpuras and cdump_analyzer versions/hashes/licenses plus device/block/selector/type/mode semantics
Authoritative HTTPS Redfish Systems/UBB Dump endpoint, credentials/CA and CPER schema
Baseline entry IDs/timestamps, exact index-selection and attachment filename/hash policy
Dedicated no-workload window and GPU/BMC/host OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT; verify no active GPU jobs/processes and preserve baseline health/logs
Do not assume numeric device0; prove UUID/OAM/BDF and block0 UMC mapping
Use authenticated validated endpoint; do not expose credentials or trust malformed DeepSeek URL
Single mode1 injection only; stop on unexpected reset/fatal state, multiple/no CPER or decode mismatch
No automatic retry; preserve artifacts and verify GPU/BMC/host recovery before cleanup
agent_execution_scope: Observe one approved injection and collect/verify CPER attachment and decode
Correlate entry timestamp and target mapping
Do not choose target, inject/retry or power-recover independently; do not decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve device/block mapping and mode1 semantics
Review decoded evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially aligned but incomplete: its `Systemsystem` CPER URL is not the source endpoint and index/log grep cannot replace attachment download plus cdump field validation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 4 -t 4 -m 1` only after mapping; use the validated source Systems/UBB Dump entries/attachment path, SCP with hashes and pinned `cdump_analyzer`.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OOB device0/block0, severity4/type4/mode1, exact CPER fields, Common branch and5/10 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate one mapped UMC parity event and prove a unique new CPER attachment decodes to that target/type/severity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable topology and entry baseline, secure endpoint/transport, artifact hashes, collision handling and explicit recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful injector return or new generic BMC log does not prove CPER location, bank, error code or fatal severity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An uncorrected fatal event can reset or strand a GPU/host; concurrent CPER producers can invalidate a simple max-index assumption.

project_override_considerations: The literal 192.168.31.1 HTTP endpoint is an example that requires approved project address/TLS/auth mapping. Preserve the Systems/UBB Dump resource semantics unless the platform owner supplies an equivalent canonical route; do not substitute the malformed DeepSeek path.
expected_evidence: Platform/BMC and device0 UUID/OAM/BDF/block0 UMC mapping plus before health/workload state
Tool hashes/versions and complete baseline CPER entry IDs/timestamps
Exact one-shot command/result and event timestamp
Validated Redfish before/after responses showing exactly one attributable new entry
Raw attachment, source/destination hashes and analyzer command/JSON
Decoded OAM/location, UMC bank, ext4, AddressCommandParityErr and uncorrected-system-fatal severity
Post-event GPU/BMC/host health/recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source command, CPER pipeline and criteria consistently specify one OOB single-shot UMC address/command-parity event. Endpoint placeholders require project resolution but do not contradict the intended resource.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tooling, numeric-target mapping, endpoint and decoder are identifiable supplyable prerequisites; the purpose and acceptance remain clear.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row179 Wistron-GPU RAS-00030-V002: approve platform/UBB/BMC/host and device0 UUID/OAM/BDF plus block0=UMC mapping; provide amdgpuras/cdump_analyzer versions/hashes/licenses and `-s4 -t4 -m1` semantics, canonical secure Systems/UBB Dump entries/attachment endpoint with auth/CA, CPER index collision/attribution and exact OAM/UMC/ext4/AddressCommandParityErr/fatal decoder schema, plus dedicated-workload and GPU/BMC/host OOB no-retry recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the actual Redfish attachment and decoder coverage, corrects the unusable DeepSeek endpoint example, and prevents a coincidental new CPER or unmapped device number from proving the case.
independent_technical_reasoning: The injector's zero exit status only proves command acceptance. The test's engineering claim is end-to-end: one mapped UMC parity stimulus must traverse the OOB RAS pipeline into one new CPER whose component, bank, extended code/type and fatal severity all agree. A max-index delta is insufficient when other dumps can be created concurrently, so entry timestamps/IDs and attachment hashes must bind the decoded JSON to the injection. Mode1 distinguishes the single-shot state and forbids retry or persistent behavior.
